connector.name: LLMIntel Model Lifecycle
connector.registryDescription: Check whether an LLM model id is deprecated, retiring, or retired, and what to migrate to.
connector.summary: Hosted at llmintel.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.llmintel, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: LLMINTEL_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. The catalog is public and needs no key; supplying one only raises the rate-limit budget.

env.name: LLMINTEL_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional. Override the catalog origin (defaults to https://llmintel.ai). Useful for self-hosted or staging deployments.
